resources.name: Cleri-Rosato embedded-atom method potential for Cu

access.notes: Commonly available in LAMMPS potential library; also from NIST Interatomic Potentials Repository. Original reference: F. Cleri, V. Rosato, Phys. Rev. B 48, 22 (1993).
GULP (General Utility Lattice Program) is open-source (https://github.com/gulp-code/gulp). LAMMPS (https://lammps.sandia.gov/) is also open-source and can be used alternatively.
Python machine learning library. Install via pip.
